title: gournal find
description: Search your entries for words.
---
<!-- Generated by npm run docs:gen. Do not edit. Edit examples in site/src/content/examples/cli/find.md. -->

Search your entries for words. Every word must match. The oldest entries come first.

## Usage

    gournal find <text> [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-p, --project <project>` | Show only entries of this project. |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Show only entries with all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |  |
| `-k, --kind <kinds>` | Show only these kinds: done, blocker, next. Separate kinds with commas. |  |
| `--status <status>` | Show only open or resolved entries. |  |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Show only entries of this repository. |  |
| `--from <date>` | Show entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `--to <date>` | Show entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Show at most this many entries, oldest first. |  |

## Examples

Find entries that match a word.

```console
$ gournal find rounding
Found 2 entries:

Nov Sun 15 - 16:04 53X22ZXF [billing-api] Fix rounding error in invoice totals #bugfix #invoices
Nov Sun 15 - 16:04 V91XZBEK [billing-api] Add a regression test for tax rounding #testing #invoices
```

Combine the search with filters. This command finds open blockers only.

```console
$ gournal find webhook --kind blocker --status open
Found 1 entries:

Nov Sun 15 - 16:04 0MC5VPCQ [billing-api] Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging #webhooks
```
